field_desc_zh: 瀑布流内容，每个带 key 的子元素为一项，适用于静态内容。（与 `items` + `renderItem` 为两种互斥的使用方式）
field_desc_en: Masonry content. Each child element with a `key` is an item, suitable for static content. (Mutually exclusive with `items` + `renderItem`)

field_desc_zh: 列数，可传入固定数值或按容器宽度断点配置（如 `{ 0: 2, 640: 3, 1024: 4 }`）
field_desc_en: Number of columns. Can be a fixed number or configured by container width breakpoints (e.g. `{ 0: 2, 640: 3, 1024: 4 }`)

field_desc_zh: 间距，可传入固定数值或按容器宽度断点配置（如 `{ 0: 8, 640: 12, 1024: 16 }`）
field_desc_en: Gap. Can be a fixed number or configured by container width breakpoints (e.g. `{ 0: 8, 640: 12, 1024: 16 }`)

field_desc_zh: 瀑布流数据源数组，配合 `renderItem` 使用，除 `key` 外不限制数据项的字段和内容
field_desc_en: Data source array of the Masonry, used together with `renderItem`. Except for `key`, the fields and content of each item are not restricted
custom_field_type: MasonryItem[]【interface MasonryItem { key: string | number; [prop: string]: any }】

field_desc_zh: 自定义渲染每一个瀑布流 item 的函数，接收数据项和索引，返回要展示的节点，配合 `items` 使用
field_desc_en: Custom render function for each Masonry item. Receives the data item and its index, and returns the node to display. Used together with `items`

field_desc_zh: 数据排布策略，可选值 `shortest`（最短列优先，将新项放入当前累计高度最小的列）、`sequential`（按序轮流，新项按固定顺序轮流放入各列）
field_desc_en: Data layout strategy. Options: `shortest` (shortest column first, place each new item into the column with the smallest current height), `sequential` (round-robin, place items into columns in a fixed order)

field_desc_zh: 瀑布流类型，可选值 `fixed-width`（固定宽度和自适应高度）、`fixed-both`（固定宽度和高度）、`fixed-height`（自适应宽度和固定高度）、`free-size`（动态宽高）
field_desc_en: Masonry grouping type. Options: `fixed-width` (fixed width and adaptive height), `fixed-both` (fixed width and height), `fixed-height` (adaptive width and fixed height), `free-size` (dynamic width and height)

event_input: (items: MasonryItemLayout[])【interface MasonryItemLayout { key: string | number; index: number; column: number; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }】
